machine.out-of-range: Stay beside the machine and finish your current action.

machine.invalid-recipe: Recipe or output data is unavailable.
machine.missing-details: Still needed: {{ingredients}}. Bring them and retry here. Nothing was consumed.

guide.title: Country Kitchen Guide
guide.routes-title: Two processing routes and their uses
guide.pierre: Pierre's General Store sells limited supplies of soybeans and wheat for tofu and soy sauce.
guide.robin: Robin's Carpenter's Shop sells the Bean Workshop and Fermentation Crock blueprints. Learn them, then craft and place the machines using vanilla materials.
guide.gus: Gus at the Stardrop Saloon sells limited Chinese toon and the Toon Tofu Salad recipe. Buy the recipe separately to learn it.
guide.route: {{station}}: use {{inputs}} to make {{output}}. {{minutes}} minutes per batch.
guide.kitchen: Learn the recipe and get access to a kitchen to cook Toon Tofu Salad from toon and tofu. Eat it, give it as a gift, or sell it to Pierre.
guide.operation: Interact beside a machine to start a batch from your backpack. Processing follows game time; close the menu and continue farming. Collect the whole batch when ready. Full bags leave products safe inside. Busy machines cannot be moved. Single-player processing is supported.
rejection.MissingIngredients: Not enough ingredients. Nothing was consumed.
rejection.InventoryFull: Make room for the whole batch. Products are still in the machine.
rejection.Busy: This machine already has a batch.
rejection.DuplicateRequest: This operation was already handled. Reopen the menu.
rejection.WrongInstance: Machine was replaced. Reopen its menu.
